list.definition:

WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY asset

panels.title: Assets
panels.description: Number of selected assets with fee entries in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset) AS assets
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Fee entries (latest day)
panels.description: Number of fee entries (contract, trade type and strategy leg combinations) for the selected assets on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) AS entries
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Average total unit cost (latest day)
panels.description: Average exchange plus registration fee per contract across the selected assets on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, exchange_fee + registration_fee AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT avg(total_fee)::DOUBLE AS avg_total_fee
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Latest trading day
panels.description: Most recent trading day with fee entries for the selected assets in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Average total unit cost
panels.description: Daily average exchange plus registration fee per contract (BRL), per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Average exchange fee
panels.description: Daily average exchange fee per contract (BRL), per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Average registration fee
panels.description: Daily average registration fee per contract (BRL), per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS registration_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Fee change since start of range
panels.description: Average change of each contract's total fee vs its first fee in the range, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    asset,
    (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
    first_value((exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
      ORDER BY trad_dt
    ) AS first_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(total_fee / nullif(first_fee, 0) - 1) AS change
FROM k
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Daily fee change
panels.description: Average change of each contract's total fee vs the previous trading day, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    asset,
    (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
    lag((exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
      ORDER BY trad_dt
    ) AS prev_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(total_fee / nullif(prev_fee, 0) - 1) AS change
FROM k
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND prev_fee IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Fee spread across contracts
panels.description: Daily highest minus lowest total fee across the listed contracts of each selected asset (BRL).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset,
  (max(exchange_fee + registration_fee) - min(exchange_fee + registration_fee))::DOUBLE AS spread
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Listed expirations
panels.description: Daily number of distinct expiration codes with a fee entry, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(DISTINCT expiration_code) AS expirations
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Fee entries, stacked by asset
panels.description: Daily number of fee entries of the selected assets, stacked so the top edge is the total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) AS entries
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Fee changes vs previous day, stacked by asset
panels.description: Daily number of fee entries whose total fee differs from the previous trading day, stacked so the top edge is the total.

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    asset,
    exchange_fee + registration_fee AS total_fee,
    lag(exchange_fee + registration_fee) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
      ORDER BY trad_dt
    ) AS prev_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) FILTER (WHERE total_fee <> prev_fee) AS changed
FROM k
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND trad_dt > (SELECT min(trad_dt) FROM k)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Newly listed entries, stacked by asset
panels.description: Daily number of fee entries that did not exist on the previous trading day (new expirations), stacked so the top edge is the total.

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    asset,
    lag(trad_dt) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
      ORDER BY trad_dt
    ) AS prev_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_dt IS NULL) AS listed
FROM k
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND trad_dt > (SELECT min(trad_dt) FROM k)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Day-trade discount vs regular
panels.description: Average day-trade total fee over the regular total fee of the same contract minus 1, per selected asset; ignores the day trade filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    asset,
    (max(exchange_fee + registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE day_trade))::DOUBLE AS day_trade_fee,
    (max(exchange_fee + registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade))::DOUBLE AS regular_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY trad_dt, market, asset, expiration_code, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(day_trade_fee / nullif(regular_fee, 0) - 1) AS discount
FROM p
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Selected assets (latest day in range)
panels.description: Entry counts and min/avg/max fees per selected asset on the latest day, with the change in average total fee vs the previous day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
lat AS (
  SELECT max(trad_dt) AS cur FROM d
),
prv AS (
  SELECT max(trad_dt) AS prev FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT cur FROM lat)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  string_agg(DISTINCT market, ', ') AS market,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) AS entries,
  count(DISTINCT expiration_code) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) AS expirations,
  avg(exchange_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur)::DOUBLE AS avg_exchange_fee,
  avg(registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur)::DOUBLE AS avg_registration_fee,
  min(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) AS min_total_fee,
  avg(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) AS avg_total_fee,
  max(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) AS max_total_fee,
  avg(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = prev) AS prev_avg_total_fee,
  avg_total_fee / nullif(prev_avg_total_fee, 0) - 1 AS avg_total_change
FROM d, lat, prv
WHERE trad_dt = cur OR trad_dt = prev
GROUP BY asset
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = cur) > 0
ORDER BY asset

panels.title: Unit costs (latest day in range)
panels.description: All fee entries of the selected assets on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  expiration_code,
  market,
  day_trade,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  bacen_auction,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Biggest fee increases (range)
panels.description: Top 15 contracts by total fee increase from first to last day in the range, in the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
c AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    expiration_code,
    day_trade,
    trade_type,
    strategy_leg,
    arg_min(total_fee, trad_dt) AS first_total_fee,
    arg_max(total_fee, trad_dt) AS last_total_fee,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM d
  GROUP BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
)
SELECT
  asset,
  expiration_code,
  day_trade,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  first_total_fee,
  last_total_fee,
  last_total_fee - first_total_fee AS delta_fee,
  last_total_fee / nullif(first_total_fee, 0) - 1 AS pct_change
FROM c
WHERE last_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND last_total_fee > first_total_fee
ORDER BY delta_fee DESC, pct_change DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest fee decreases (range)
panels.description: Top 15 contracts by total fee decrease from first to last day in the range, in the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
c AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    expiration_code,
    day_trade,
    trade_type,
    strategy_leg,
    arg_min(total_fee, trad_dt) AS first_total_fee,
    arg_max(total_fee, trad_dt) AS last_total_fee,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM d
  GROUP BY market, asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg, bacen_auction
)
SELECT
  asset,
  expiration_code,
  day_trade,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  first_total_fee,
  last_total_fee,
  last_total_fee - first_total_fee AS delta_fee,
  last_total_fee / nullif(first_total_fee, 0) - 1 AS pct_change
FROM c
WHERE last_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND last_total_fee < first_total_fee
ORDER BY delta_fee ASC, pct_change ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Most expensive assets (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 assets by average total fee per contract on the latest day, in the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset,
  string_agg(DISTINCT market, ', ') AS market,
  count(*) AS entries,
  avg(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS avg_exchange_fee,
  avg(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS avg_registration_fee,
  avg(total_fee) AS avg_total_fee,
  max(total_fee) AS max_total_fee
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY avg_total_fee DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest fee changes vs previous day (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 50 total fee changes (BRL) vs the previous day on the latest day, in the selected markets; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT
  c.asset,
  c.expiration_code,
  c.day_trade,
  c.trade_type,
  c.strategy_leg,
  p.total_fee AS prev_total_fee,
  c.total_fee AS total_fee,
  c.total_fee - p.total_fee AS delta_fee,
  c.total_fee / nullif(p.total_fee, 0) - 1 AS pct_change
FROM cur c
JOIN prv p
  ON c.market = p.market
  AND c.asset = p.asset
  AND c.expiration_code = p.expiration_code
  AND c.day_trade = p.day_trade
  AND c.trade_type = p.trade_type
  AND c.strategy_leg IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.strategy_leg
  AND c.bacen_auction IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.bacen_auction
WHERE c.total_fee <> p.total_fee
ORDER BY abs(c.total_fee - p.total_fee) DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: $asset total fee across contracts
panels.description: Daily lowest, median, average and highest total fee across the listed contracts, one panel per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  min(exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Min",
  median(exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Median",
  avg(exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Average",
  max(exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Max"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset = $asset
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: $asset unit cost by expiration (latest day)
panels.description: Exchange and registration fee per expiration on the latest day (first 60 expirations, month-year codes in maturity order), one panel per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset = $asset
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  expiration_code,
  avg(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Exchange fee",
  avg(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Registration fee"
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY expiration_code
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(expiration_code, '[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}')
    THEN make_date(2000 + right(expiration_code, 2)::INT, instr('FGHJKMNQUVXZ', left(expiration_code, 1)), 1)
  END NULLS LAST,
  expiration_code
LIMIT 60
